t: You're looking at Blackfriars Railway Bridge, which carries trains across the Thames between Blackfriars Bridge and the Millennium Bridge. It was designed by two engineers. Sir John Wolfe-Barry is best known for engineering Tower Bridge, built between 1886 and 1894. Henry Marc Brunel was the son of Isambard Kingdom Brunel and grandson of Marc Isambard Brunel, and he also worked with Wolfe-Barry on Tower Bridge. So this railway crossing was shaped by the same pair of engineers who gave London its most famous bridge.
